title: Pair selection inverts the slot map
statement: For every finite Boolean Turing machine $M$ and either of the two roles $i$ (argument or capture), selecting a role at its physical call-layout index returns that same role.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$i$ is one of the two roles
replaced:
For each of the finalizer's two tape roles, selecting at its physical call-layout index
returns exactly that role.
